## Pricing

- NOVA BASE (₹24,999): 5 pages, custom UI/UX, responsive, WhatsApp, basic forms, free domain & hosting.
- NOVA PRO (₹34,999): 10 pages, technical SEO setup, analytics, basic backend, up to 2 API integrations.
- NOVA MAX (₹54,999): 15 pages, advanced SEO, full backend & database, up to 3 API integrations.
